question_text: What is your primary software delivery model (B2B Enterprise SaaS, B2C Consumer App, or AI/ML Platform)?
remediation_action: Determine software delivery model to route conditional privacy and liability diligence.

question_text: Has the company completed an independent SOC 2 Type II audit covering Security, Availability, and Confidentiality?
remediation_action: Engage an external auditing firm to conduct a SOC 2 readiness assessment and establish an observation window.

question_text: Does the software architecture rely on any viral copyleft open-source licenses (e.g., GPL, AGPL) that could legally force the public disclosure of proprietary source code?
remediation_action: Run a Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tool to identify and replace all copyleft dependencies.

question_text: Is the platform fully compliant with the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) and GDPR, including automated workflows for Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs) and data deletion?
remediation_action: Publish a compliant privacy policy and automate DSAR deletion and opt-out workflows.

question_text: Do active enterprise Service Level Agreements (SLAs) contain unlimited financial liability caps or automatic termination clauses for uptime failures?
remediation_action: Renegotiate standard Master Services Agreements (MSAs) to cap financial liability at 12 months of contract value.

question_text: Are core product functionalities entirely dependent on a single third-party API (e.g., OpenAI, Stripe, AWS) without a fallback or redundancy plan?
remediation_action: Architect multi-cloud failovers or integrate secondary API providers to eliminate single points of failure.

question_text: Are proprietary machine learning models trained on user/customer data, and do the Terms of Service (TOS) explicitly grant the right to use this data for training purposes?
remediation_action: Update TOS to explicitly require opt-in/opt-out consent for model training and implement strict data anonymization protocols.

question_text: Are there defined Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Plans (BCP) with documented and tested Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO)?
remediation_action: Draft and execute an annual tabletop exercise for a catastrophic server failure to validate RTO/RPO targets.

question_text: Is all customer data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+), and are encryption keys managed via a secure KMS?
remediation_action: Enforce database field-level encryption and configure a centralized Key Management Service (KMS).

question_text: Is Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) enforced across all internal systems, requiring Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and following the principle of least privilege?
remediation_action: Mandate SSO and MFA for all employee accounts and conduct a quarterly access privilege audit.

question_text: Was any portion of the core source code written by offshore contractors or third-party dev shops without a signed, explicit Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement?
remediation_action: Execute retroactive IP Assignment and Work-for-Hire agreements with all historical external contributors.

question_text: Does the company maintain a formalized Cyber Incident Response Plan (CIRP) detailing escalation procedures and legal notification timelines for data breaches?
remediation_action: Formalize a cyber incident playbook with a strict materiality assessment and legal escalation triggers.
